definitions.explanation: Things of various sizes; the contrast between big and small.
The dimension or magnitude of something.

examples.japanese: {大小|だいしょう}⟦さまざまな→さまざま：01559_samazama⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Stones of various sizes are lined up.

examples.japanese: {大小|だいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{平等|びょうどう}→平等：03590_byoudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: To treat equally regardless of size.

examples.japanese: {大小|だいしょう}⟦2つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I prepared two boxes, one large and one small.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大小|だいしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かかわらず⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please report regardless of the magnitude of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大小|だいしょう}⟦さまざまな→さまざま：01559_samazama⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This job has risks of various magnitudes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大小|だいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They are investigating the extent of the damage.

notes:
{大小|だいしょう} combines {大|だい} (large) and {小|しょう} (small). It refers either to things of various sizes or to size as a concept.

USAGE:
As a noun, it can mean both 'large and small things' and 'size' (as a dimension).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大小|だいしょう}さまざまな: of various sizes
- {大小|だいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: difference in size
- {大小|だいしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かかわらず: regardless of size
- {大小|だいしょう}⟦2つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: two ~, one large and one small

SIMILAR COMPOUND PATTERNS:
- ⟦{多少|たしょう}→多少：01647_tashou⟧: more or less, somewhat (quantity)
- ⟦{長短|ちょうたん}→長短：05558_choutan⟧: long and short; pros and cons
- ⟦{高低|こうてい}→高低：21533_koutei⟧: high and low; pitch variation

These paired-kanji compounds (⟦{対義語|たいぎご}→対義語：29399_taigigo⟧ combinations) are common in Japanese.
